correctness.rationale: The fourth moment is both the square-sum of all aperiodic autocorrelations and of all ordered-pair convolution coefficients. Three free character-phase modulations fix corner and its two neighbors uniquely, leaving q^5 normalized arrays. A fully specified exact standard-library certificate enumerates all 12,200 cases for q=2..6; checks the two independently assembled fourth moments for every array; uses Gaussian/Eisenstein integer arithmetic or exactly ordered Z[sqrt5] representations; and derives all equality cases and q^3 lifts. It is a bounded exhaustive proof, not a sample. The no-aliasing transfer at grid orders at least 5 is proved by frequency support of P^2.

value.rationale: The center-deleted 3x3 square is a natural minimal eight-site symmetric sparse optical/spectral array, distinct from the full square and 3D cube. Exact low-alphabet sidelobe energy and complete optimal phase-coding patterns supply reproducible discrete-phase baselines for hardware-limited array design. The q3 increase, q5 irrational golden-ratio improvement, and unusually rigid q6 two-orbit optimum are motivated structural transitions, not an isolated arbitrary number. No claim is made for continuous phases or larger alphabets.
